declarations.state_ownership: Owns its own PostgreSQL database cognitive_os in the cognitive-db service, never the shared Supabase (Projects/internal/cognitive-engineering-os/docs/platform/STORAGE_SWITCH.md:3-5, D8 :18; ops/cognitive-db/docker-compose.cognitive-db.yml): tenants and identities, projects, records, Sources, AI artifacts, runs, groups, research exports and the erasure outbox, built by Alembic versions 0001_baseline to 0008_hot_path_indexes (ai_lego/data/migrations/versions). Data is kept per region; COGNITIVE_OS_DATABASE_URLS maps region to database and one tenant -> region directory is the only cross-region table (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D6 :16). Blobs (Source CAS, artifacts, run journals) live on disk in the per-region volume cognitive-os-files (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D7 :17; docker-compose.yml cognitive-os-api volumes). The runtime lives in Projects/internal/cognitive-engineering-os; lib/cognitive in next-admin holds only this manifest.
declarations.behavior_ownership: Composing cognitive methods, recipes, research projects and their evidence: ai_lego/modules (method and recipe blocks), ai_lego/platform/workflow (workflows), ai_lego/platform/ai_execution (contract and capability catalogs; CapabilityCatalog.invoke is the capability entry, capability_resolver.py:65, contract_catalog.py:145), ai_lego/platform/erasure.py (case and account erasure), ai_lego/platform/net (all outbound calls). HTTP API ai_lego/apps/api/main.py; web UI apps/cognitive-web (Next.js).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP API on cognitive-os-api :8420 (ai_lego/apps/api/main.py, 66 routes in the committed version): /health (:732), /auth/*, /projects/* (29 routes), /methods/*, /recipes/*, /workflows/*, /interpretations/*, /ai/status and /ai/draft/method|recipe/{id} (:1597, :1642, :1664), /projects/{project_id}/collections (:3432), /collect-grants, /catalog, /capabilities, /artifacts, /sources. The web replicas call it at COS_API_ORIGIN (docker-compose.yml cognitive-os-web environment). Outbound: Anthropic, and the AwareWave collect product at COGNITIVE_OS_COLLECTION_SERVICE_URL (ai_lego/platform/net/collection_service.py:18, :60) which answers at next-admin /api/internal/collect/runs.
declarations.invariants: Every outbound call goes through ai_lego/platform/net/egress.py: https only and deny-by-default against COGNITIVE_OS_NETWORK_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST (egress.py:48-52, docker-compose.yml cognitive-os-api environment; parity with policy EGRESS-EC99-2 tested by tests/unit/test_egress_allowlist_parity.py). One aggregate's events are totally ordered with no gap or duplicate; nothing is written to an erased case; a tenant's rows and blobs stay in its region (STORAGE_SWITCH.md invariants 1, 3, 4 at :22-28). The engine refuses to start when the schema is not at head and never auto-migrates in production (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D2 :12). Erasure does nothing irreversible before the decision it depends on is durable, and a durable decision can always be finished (ai_lego/platform/erasure.py:1-6).
declarations.dependencies: Its own services cognitive-os-api, cognitive-os-web (+ -web-2, -web-3) and cognitive-db (Projects/internal/cognitive-engineering-os/docker-compose.yml, ops/cognitive-db/docker-compose.cognitive-db.yml), Anthropic for AI drafting (COGNITIVE_OS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; absent key -> /ai/* 503 AI_PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED, main.py:663, :1562), and the AwareWave collect product for research collection (products.ts dependsOn ["collect"]; collection_service.py:60); collect's own services and env come from lib/collect/MODULE_MANIFEST.json through that dependsOn closure, not from this list. No Supabase, no Trigger, no Redis (ADR 017 section 5 row cognitive and its evidence list). Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row cognitive.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: A missing Anthropic key disables only /ai/* (503) and every other route keeps working (docker-compose.yml cognitive-os-api env_file comment; main.py:1562); the daily AI token budget refuses further drafting with AI_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED instead of spending (main.py:1527). Its database, volume and containers are separate from next-admin and Supabase (docker-compose.yml, ops/cognitive-db). A deploy tags the running image :rollback before building and restores it when health or smoke fails (deploy/deploy.sh:139-143, HEALTH_URLS :19).
declarations.data_lifecycle: DELETE /projects/{id} and account deletion run one durable, idempotent erasure: rows and the outbox entry commit first, files named in the outbox are removed afterwards (ai_lego/platform/erasure.py:1-15; Alembic 0004_erasure_outbox). Subject keys support crypto-shredding (ai_lego/security/__init__.py:1, key_vault). Nightly host-side pg_dump of cognitive-db (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D8 :18; ops/cognitive-db/backup-cognitive-db.sh, README.md:40-46) with documented restore (ops/cognitive-db/restore-cognitive-db.md).
declarations.observability_contract: GET /health on the API and /login on the web for health checks (docker-compose.yml healthchecks; deploy/deploy.sh:19); GET /ai/status reports AI availability (main.py:1597); PostgreSQL logs statements slower than one second (docker-compose.cognitive-db.yml command log_min_duration_statement=1000); deploy.sh follows the deployable-service checklist test gate -> healthcheck -> smoke -> rollback -> notification (deploy.sh:3).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Alembic with raw-SQL migrations, explicit migration step in deploy and never automatic (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D2 :12; deploy/deploy.sh:9); 8 of the 8 versions define downgrade() (grep def downgrade in ai_lego/data/migrations/versions; 0001_baseline.py:319). deploy.sh rolls back the image and takes a pre-deploy dump through the cognitive-db backup script (deploy/lib-db.sh:77, deploy.sh:9). The SQLite volume from before the move is kept untouched as the rollback source (docker-compose.yml cognitive-os-api volumes comment).
declarations.replacement_strategy: Capabilities are reached only through CapabilityCatalog.invoke, so an implementation is swapped behind its contract (ai_lego/platform/ai_execution/contract_catalog.py:145); storage is one thin module ai_lego/data/db.py with plain PostgreSQL and no ORM (STORAGE_SWITCH.md D1 :11); every outbound host is one entry in the egress allowlist (egress.py). Collection is a client of the collect product's HTTP contract (collection_service.py), replaceable by another service answering it.

acceptance.test: an outbound call to a host that is not on the egress allowlist
acceptance.expect: 呼叫在送出前被拒絕，不產生任何網路連線
專案的紀錄、來源與 AI 產出都被移除，之後無法再寫入該專案

configuration.apiKeys: COGNITIVE_OS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (optional COGNITIVE_OS_AI_MODEL and daily token budgets), all in deploy/.env on the host (deploy/.env.example). COGNITIVE_OS_COLLECTION_SERVICE_URL points at the customer's own collect installation.
configuration.generatedByInstall: COGNITIVE_OS_DATABASE_URLS and the cognitive_db_password secret (ops/cognitive-db/install-cognitive-db.sh), COGNITIVE_OS_JOURNAL_KEY_MODE / COGNITIVE_OS_JOURNAL_KEY_B64, COLLECT_RESEARCH_RUNS_TOKEN (same value as the collect installation), ENTITLEMENT_* (deploy/.env.example); COGNITIVE_OS_NETWORK_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST must name the customer's collect host instead of app.aware-wave.com (docker-compose.yml).
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names a service of its compose file; the installer installs both whole compose files (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
